title: Reconcile current open Pull Requests and Issues for release
rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。

declaredIntent.summary: Refresh #662 from current main and use provider-bound evidence to compress open PR and Issue backlog into terminal, superseded, or exact-active dispositions before release.

outOfScope: Implementation changes for individual remediation Issues, including #709, #659, #680, #681, and #665.
Modification of any archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, manifest, or historical reconciliation record.
Provider mutations other than documented issue/PR disposition comments and closures justified by this Work Item.
Deletion of local or remote branches; lifecycle closure owns exact work-branch cleanup only.

sources.reason: Release-blocking reconciliation requirements and permitted dispositions.
Current merged #664 delivery and hosted verification evidence.
Frozen predecessor inventory; retained as historical evidence and not treated as current truth.
Repository lifecycle, archival, merge, and cleanup rules.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrectly closing a provider item or treating stale evidence as terminal could contaminate the release path; every disposition must cite current provider and repository evidence.

reasons: Reconciliation changes release-governance evidence and provider dispositions but does not implement runtime behavior.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized automatic execution; the Contract limits reconciliation to evidence-backed provider dispositions and generated records.

preReviewWarnings: Review each claimed terminal disposition against the exact issue/PR, merge SHA, archived Outcome, closure receipt, and current branch state.
Reject a disposition when its provider or archive evidence is stale, ambiguous, or incomplete.

checkpointPolicy.reason: This cleanup Work Item has no implementation-code edit phase; record the final provider inventory and disposition boundary before finishing.

acceptance: The reconciliation JSON contains one observed record for each provider item returned by the bounded open-PR and open-Issue inventory commands, with item number, type, state, observed-at timestamp, evidence references, disposition, and exact next gate.
The reconciliation Markdown renders the same observed inventory and explicitly identifies the historical #662 snapshot as non-current evidence.

For PR #741 and PR #738, record provider facts that justify quarantine or closure without merging archived-incompatible work; do not mutate them until the record cites exact successor or conflict evidence.
The JSON sets releaseMayBegin to false whenever any observed item is active, unclassified, stale, conflicting, or lacks the evidence required by its disposition.
guidelines: Generated reconciliation records must clearly distinguish observed provider facts, evidence, terminal dispositions, and exact next gates.
Do not alter individual remediation implementation or immutable historical evidence while reconciling release inventory.

intent.problem: The archived #662 reconciliation snapshot is stale: it observed 38 open issues and one stale PR, while the current provider inventory has 34 open issues and three PRs. Without a current, evidence-backed classification, issue counts obscure which work is delivered, superseded, stale, or genuinely unresolved.
constraints: Use provider and repository evidence, not branch names or test claims alone.
Keep release #625 blocked until every release-relevant item has a verified terminal disposition or exact active corrective gate.
intent.rationale: A current reconciliation removes accounting drift before further remediation and prevents stale PRs and duplicate issues from expanding the plan.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Pull Request is green and mergeable with a matching archived Work Item and provider head identity.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reconciliation records the exact merge/closure next gate and does not classify it as terminal until provider merge and lifecycle closure are both verified.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect provider check rollup, merge SHA, archived Outcome, closure receipt, and remote branch state.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A historical PR is conflicting, archived, or explicitly superseded by a merged successor.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The record identifies quarantine/closure eligibility and successor evidence without rebasing, merging, or rewriting the historical archive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare provider PR mergeability, head ancestry, archived evidence, successor PR merge record, and Issue acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An Issue appears delivered or has a predecessor/successor relationship but its acceptance or provider closure is incomplete.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The record leaves it active with an exact corrective gate; release readiness remains blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Cross-check current Issue state, linked PRs, current main content, archived Outcomes, and #625 prerequisites.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
